translations.Bitstream требует совместимого HDMI/S/PD: Bitstream requires a compatible HDMI/S/PDIF output, driver and receiver. Processing, ReplayGain, an explicit layout, two outputs, speed other than 1×, DRC or decoder downmix use PCM. Bitstream settings are kept and restored after conflicts are removed. While bitstream is allowed, forced PCM format/rate are bypassed; libmpv decodes unsupported streams. Software volume does not control receiver level in bitstream mode. Parameter changes restart the audio track and may briefly interrupt sound. DRC requires AC-3 metadata. Decoder preference retains automatic fallback; not all codecs support threads. The mixer disables decoder downmix.

Software fallback, minimizing or a conflict temporarily uses audio sync while retaining your selection. Interpolation applies only in display mode. Qt refresh rate is a hint, not a VBlank measurement; drivers and compositors may ignore VSync. This does not change monitor modes or enable HDR.

Online previews send extra network requests and are off by default. Live inputs, unknown durations and growing sources are excluded. Width is limited to 160–960 pixels; cache is limited to 16 MiB.

translations.Программный фильтр использует libswscale: Software scaling uses libswscale; an explicit choice disables zimg. Default restores the original libmpv options. The three OpenGL filters apply only to GPU output. Software fallback retains these selections but uses its software scaler. These settings affect frame scaling, not Pan&Scan geometry.

An RGB display profile up to 16 MiB is required. ICC overrides the selected OpenGL primaries and transfer curve. It does not apply in Software. Automatic OS profile selection and per-monitor assignment are not available yet. The libmpv LUT cache is disabled; nothing is written to system folders.

translations.Пустой или недоступный файл — встроенное: An empty or unavailable file uses the built-in image. Paths are relative to the program folder. Toolbar: PNG/BMP with 10 square FoxicMP icons or 15/16 Classic icons in a row; unsupported buttons use built-in icons.
translations.Пустой свой список кодеков выключает апп: An empty custom codec list disables hardware decoding. An unavailable method or unsupported stream falls back to CPU decoding. Copy-back supports software filters; it is not direct GPU output. Changing the decoder can briefly interrupt video. Threading depends on the codec. Deinterlacing defaults off: enable it for interlaced video; it may reduce progressive video quality. libmpv chooses the algorithm.

translations.Редактируйте начало, конец и текст. Врем: Edit start, end and text. Time format: hh:mm:ss,ms. Double-click the cue number to seek to it. The original changes only when you explicitly save to the same file.
translations.Редактор одного GLSL hook на элемент: ve: One GLSL hook per entry: vec4 hook(), HOOKED_tex/texOff and HOOKED_pos coordinates. Up to 16 entries, 64 KiB each. mpv metadata, directives, compute and multi-pass files are not supported here. Order applies within each stage; MAIN always precedes SCALED. Validation compiles OpenGL 3.3 in a separate process; it does not verify the player GPU result. Shaders have no effect in Software. OK stores source in INI and generates Shaders files beside the program; Cancel applies nothing.

One GLSL hook editor per element: vec4 hook(), HOOKED_tex/texOff and HOOKED_pos coordinates. Up to 16 elements of 64 KiB each. mpv metadata is unsupported except //!HOOK, //!DESC and //!BIND HOOKED. mpv GLSL import adds several independent passes; //!SAVE, //!WHEN and compute are rejected. Order applies within each stage; MAIN always comes before SCALED. Checking compiles with OpenGL 3.3 in a separate process, rather than checking the player GPU result. Shaders do not apply in Software mode. OK stores text in INI and generates Shaders files next to the program; Cancel applies nothing.
